<ic>To appoint a Captain of the Senate Guard<br><br><i>Proposed by Bastion, seconded by Kallavesa.</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* This motion was to choose a citizen to appoint as [[Captain of the Senate Guard]].

===Date===
* Autumn 379YE.

===Outcome===
* Sergio Salvatore was elected
